statement: Adjacent literature already treats two of the listed distinctions as known concerns in nearby settings: adaptive control of subgraph expansion is an explicit motivation for EntropyRAG (2026, GNN-based entropy-aware retrieval with soft-prompt injection of the subgraph, evaluated on WebQSP/CWQ), and systematic comparisons of augmentation strategies (RAG vs fine-tuning across twelve LMs and several fine-tuning methods) exist in arxiv:2403.01432. Neither performs a matched-token/matched-example comparison between supervision regimes, so the distinctions remain unclaimed for the idea's exact setting, but context-size control and augmentation-strategy comparison are not themselves novel ideas.
